auth_type.correction: none for anonymous public SODA 2.1 reads; an optional app token provides identification and increased throttling allowances but is not API-key authentication

free_tier_limits.correction: Free community access is available. Anonymous SODA 2.1 requests share a lower IP-based pool; app-token requests are currently unthrottled unless abusive or malicious. No numeric cap is stated.

rate_limits.correction: Published policy: anonymous requests may be throttled through a shared IP-based pool; app-token requests are currently not throttled unless abusive or malicious; throttling returns HTTP 429.

cors.correction: supported for read-only access to public datasets

notes: The API is operational, but the entry conflates an app token with API-key authentication, overlooks published throttling and CORS policies, and uses the former host for tazs-3rd5, which is now documented under cos-data.seattle.gov. The qualitative description is plausible, but the claim of hundreds of datasets was not authoritatively quantified.
